title: PQC Certificate Rotation Requirements for Multi-Tenant PKI Environments
description: Source repository for the IETF Internet-Draft draft-vicente-pquip-multitenant-pki-requirements. Specifies requirements and identifies gaps for post-quantum certificate rotation in multi-tenant public key infrastructure environments. IETF PQUIP Working Group. Author: Brian Vicente, Sanctum SecOps LLC.
